options.content: Run an example (`./build/examples/microtel_example_basic_trace`) and its trace appears below within a few seconds — click a row to open the flame graph. The table is the TraceQL query `{}`, which matches every trace; edit the panel, or use **Explore → Tempo**, to filter (e.g. `{ resource.service.name = "microtel-basic-example" }`). The example prints its trace ID — paste it into Explore → Tempo → **TraceQL** to jump straight to it.
